userGuide.title: User guide
userGuide.subtitle: Zalo Assistant — account portal, licenses, and Chrome extension how-to.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.p1: Zalo Assistant is a Chrome extension for automating tasks on Zalo Web (chat.zalo.me): scan phone lists, send bulk friend requests, and message templates.
intro.p2: This website handles registration, login, license purchase, activation, and account management. The extension uses the same API for auth and license checks.
intro.p3: Requirements: Chrome/Chromium, an active Zalo Web session, and a valid license.

gettingStarted.title: 2. Getting started
gettingStarted.p1: Follow these steps to get an account and trial license:
gettingStarted.s1: Register on the Sign up page (or receive credentials from an admin).
gettingStarted.s2: Log in on the web or in the Chrome extension with email and password.
gettingStarted.s3: Self-registered users may receive a 1-day trial license — admins can send a welcome email with the key.
gettingStarted.s4: Open My License, enter the key, and activate before using the extension.

licenseBasics.title: 3. License basics
licenseBasics.p1: Each license is a unique key. Status flow: unused → active → expired or blocked.
licenseBasics.p2: Duration starts at first activation, not at purchase or when an admin creates the key.
licenseBasics.p3: Keys limit the number of devices. Extension and web may have different deviceIds — activate on the extension if that is your primary client.

activate.title: 4. Activate your license
activate.p1: You can activate on the web or in the extension:
activate.s2: Open My License from the sidebar.
activate.s3: Paste the license key (from email, admin, or after purchase).
activate.s4: Click Activate, then Verify if you need to confirm status and expiry.

purchase.title: 5. Buy a license
purchase.p1: On Overview, pick a plan and pay by bank transfer:
purchase.s1: Choose a package (1 day, 3/6/12/24 months) and click Buy.
purchase.s2: Scan the QR code or transfer the exact amount with the reference code (DH…).
purchase.s3: Complete payment within the countdown (~2 minutes). The system confirms via the bank webhook.
purchase.s4: After payment, go to My License to activate the new key.
purchase.s5: The 1-day package can only be purchased once per account.

licenseRequest.title: 6. Request a 1-day license
licenseRequest.p1: If you have no key yet, you can request a free 1-day license pending admin approval.
licenseRequest.p2: Only one pending request per account is recommended.
licenseRequest.s1: On Overview, find the 1-day license request section.
licenseRequest.s2: Add an optional note and submit.
licenseRequest.s3: Once approved, activate the key on My License.

extension.title: 7. Chrome extension
extension.p1: Install Zalo Assistant from the Chrome Web Store (or a .crx provided by the developer).
extension.p2: Phone lists and message templates are usually stored locally — see the Privacy policy for what is sent to the server.
extension.s1: Open chat.zalo.me and sign in to Zalo Web.
extension.s2: Open the extension popup and log in with the same web account.
extension.s3: Ensure the license is activated — the extension validates it periodically.
extension.s4: Upload Excel/CSV phone lists, configure content, and run tasks as described in the extension UI.

account.title: 8. Account & support
account.p1: Manage your profile and contact admin when needed:
account.s1: Click your avatar → Profile to view details and change password.
account.s2: Device mismatch errors: ask admin to reset the bound device before logging in on a new machine.
account.s3: Expired license: buy a new plan on Overview or contact admin.

faq.title: 9. FAQ
faq.p1: Q: Web login says another device is bound? — A: The account may be tied to another extension/device. Use the original device or ask admin to unbind.
faq.p2: Q: Verify fails on web but extension works? — A: Web and extension use different deviceIds. Activate/verify where you actually use the product.
faq.p3: Q: Paid but no license yet? — A: Check amount and transfer reference; wait a few minutes. If the pending order expired, create a new one.
faq.p4: Q: No Sign up button? — A: Public registration may be disabled — contact admin for an account.

admin.title: 10. Admin guide
admin.s1: Licenses — create keys, detail view, extend, block/unblock, revoke devices, soft delete; Excel import/export.
admin.s2: Package pricing — edit prices and time-limited promotions.
admin.s4: Users — create users, block/unblock, reset device, welcome email, change registration source; Excel import/export.
admin.s5: Overview — quick stats and test purchase flow.
admin.s6: Admin-created keys also start counting duration at user activation — remind users to activate promptly.
